items.description: Maxence puts up the marking of the upper loop on the weekend of April 11, corrected from April 18 because of a wedding; asked by Ludivine and accepted by Maxence.
items.notes: One commitment corrected in place by its owner; April 18 is no longer the date. Original statement at turn 4; change at turn 35, 31 turns later.

items.description: Rosalie asks the White Cross first aiders for an agreement this week; her attempt to hand it to Ludivine was declined, so she keeps it.
items.notes: Handover suggested at turn 29 and declined at turn 30; Ludivine never accepts.

items.description: Anselme redoes the complete budget table with the new registration fees by the end of February; Maxence questioned its usefulness and Anselme kept it.
items.notes: A third party cannot drop it; the owner rejects the challenge at turn 25.

items.description: Anselme's commitment to hand the traffic plan in at the gendarmerie before February 15, superseded by the handover to Maxence.
items.notes: Anselme commits at turn 9 and hands over at turn 31.

items.description: Maxence takes over the traffic plan and hands it in at the gendarmerie before February 15.
items.notes: Handover accepted by the new owner at turn 32.

items.description: Rosalie's commitment to book the minibus before December 15, questioned by Anselme and later withdrawn by Rosalie herself in favour of the town shuttle.
items.notes: The challenge at turn 28 changes nothing; only Rosalie's own withdrawal at turn 37 counts. Original statement at turn 15; change at turn 37, 22 turns later.

items.description: Decision to give a merino wool buff to every finisher, superseded by the later return to the medal.
items.notes: Adopted at turn 17 with Maxence and Rosalie agreeing; reversed because the buff costs eleven euros each. Original statement at turn 17; change at turn 36, 19 turns later.

items.description: Decision to give a medal to every finisher, replacing the merino buff because of its price.
items.notes: Put to the group by Ludivine at turn 36; nobody objects.

items.description: Ludivine's proposal of bib pickup on Friday evening was rejected by Maxence, who suggested Saturday from two in the afternoon; no choice was settled.
items.notes: Maxence's alternative is a counter-proposal, not a group decision.

items.description: Maxence opens the community hall for bib pickup, in the same turn where he rejects Friday and suggests Saturday.
items.notes: A firm commitment inside a turn that also declines and proposes.

items.description: Ludivine writes only the short version of the race rules, one page for the website, instead of the complete rules with penalties, by early March.
items.notes: Deliverable reduced by its owner; the complete rules are no longer promised. Original statement at turn 20; change at turn 34, 14 turns later.

items.description: Maxence books the start tents at the town hall on Monday; first quoted by Ludivine, then confirmed by Maxence in his own words.
items.notes: Not a commitment at turn 23; Maxence commits at turn 33.

items.description: Dorian, absent, would run the aid station at the Eagles pass with friends from the ski club, according to Maxence.
items.notes: Dorian does not speak in the meeting.

items.description: Idea of adding ten euros to registrations made after March 31, deferred until registration numbers are seen.
Anselme had accepted to have five hundred flyers printed before the end of January; Ludivine cancelled the request because the tourist offices take a digital version.
items.notes: Cancelled by the requester. Original statement at turn 12; change at turn 38, 26 turns later.

forbidden.description: No live task owned by Ludivine for the first aiders agreement: she declined the handover.
Maxence walking the course a week before each race is a personal habit, not a task.
No live task for the minibus booking.
No live task for printing the flyers.
No live task owned by Anselme for the traffic plan: it moved to Maxence.
No firm task owned by Dorian for the aid station.
The merino buff is not a live decision.

forbidden_claims: Maxence puts up the marking on the weekend of April 18.
Ludivine writes the complete race rules with penalties.
Ludivine or anyone else took over the first aiders agreement from Rosalie.
Anselme still owns the traffic plan.
Every finisher receives a merino buff.
Dorian is in charge of the aid station.
The ten euro late fee was adopted.
Bib pickup was set on Friday evening or on Saturday.
A calendar date is given for the Monday tent booking.
detail_checks: Four Passes trail race on Sunday April 26, a hundred and eighty runners signed up.
Community hall lent for free for bib pickup, cleaning costs sixty euros.
Maxence's marking moved to the weekend of April 11 because of a wedding.
Merino buff costs eleven euros each, which exceeds the budget, so the medal returns.
Ludivine's rules reduced to a one-page short version for the website.
Traffic plan to be handed in at the gendarmerie before February 15.
Flyers cancelled because the tourist offices take the digital version.
